sloka: मानुषी मानुषस्यैव भार्यात्वं बहु मन्यसे ।प्रत्याहर मनो रामान्न त्वं जातु भविष्यसि ।। ५.२२.३।।।।
transliteration: mānuṣī mānuṣasyaiva bhāryātvaṁ bahu manyase ।pratyāhara mano rāmānna tvaṁ jātu bhaviṣyasi ।। 5.22.3।।।।

translations.english: "My love for you has restrained my anger, just as a good charioteer controls the horses galloping on a wrong path.
translations.hindi: प्रौर सीता के निकट पहुँच क्रुद्ध हो उनसे बड़े कठोर यह बच्चन . बोलीं
